verdict.rationale: MX documents official Web and React Native SDKs, but both are for embedding the Connect Widget rather than general client libraries for the Platform API. The published OpenAPI spec, Postman import and GitHub repo are building blocks for generating clients, not SDKs themselves. missing for 10: official server-side SDKs or client libraries for the Platform API (e.g. Node, Python, Ruby, Java), SDK reference docs or versioning details, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
